description: Negative fixture: a card claims adjacent-standard open level L3 while it has only attained ascent grade G0. Reading ascent_grade as the external gate_id would let this pass; R5 must REJECT it. 负向样例:仅达成 G0 的卡认领 L3 开放等级——把 ascent_grade 当 gate_id 用就会放行,R5 必须拒绝。
